title: The Vatican's sun cross and pine cone

tellings.quote: the pope and the Vatican have that very same cross not only that the pope has it on its his um on its cloak and in front of the Vatican is a giant pine cone

plain: The pope wears an ancient sun cross symbol on his cloak, and a giant pine cone sculpture stands in front of the Vatican, the seat of the Catholic Church. The researcher Matt LaCroix points this out without naming a source, saying the Church carries the very same symbols as much older cultures.
